About Toolstack Lab Games

Toolstack Lab Games is where Toolstack Lab publishes the small 3D browser games it makes. Every game is our own; press Play and it loads right in the page. No accounts, no cookies, no third-party scripts or fonts.

What you get

  • Games we made ourselves. Each game page shows its licence and source.
  • Nothing heavy loads until you press Play. You can also open any game in its own tab.
  • The ranking uses visits from the last 14 days. “Recently played” stays on your device only.

The lab cartridge idea

Every game gets the same cartridge card with a label plate and a serial number (TSL·01, TSL·02…). On a game page, Play docks the cartridge into the play bay. That is the one bit of motion on the site; there are no video or 3D backgrounds.

Who the games are for

Spud Fling suits anyone who likes quick one-button rounds. Pip's Bloom Isle is aimed at casual players 13+. We only describe what each build already ships. The content policy sets out which games may be listed.

Contact

Parent site: gettoolstacklab.com. The hub's source is public on GitHub as madlouse/toolstack-games.

How the hub works

  1. 1Pick a cartridge. Each game is one card: a real in-game frame, a short pitch, three tags.
  2. 2Press Play. The game docks into the play bay on its page and starts loading at once.
  3. 3Play in the page. Nothing to install. Progress stays in your own browser.
